mejoras.titulo: <div class="field field-name-title-field field-type-text field-label-hidden"><div class="field-items"><div class="field-item even">Doc 12 - Car Presentation Submissions

mejoras.detalle: Larger Cooling Louvres To cope with the specific power unit cooling challenges in Mexico, the cooling louvres have been extended forwards and reshaped.

Additional cooling exit louvres To recover cooling mass flow through the radiators, the exit area has been increased by extending the area of the existing louvres and optional louvres further outboard. 2 Sidepod Performance Local Load Revised sidepod and floor to sidepod split line Attached to existing sidepod geometry to improve the flow characteristics below the inlet to the radiator duct gainin

Enlarged rear bodywork exit, additional top sidepod louvre panels Specific to the requirements of the Mexico City circuit, th ese new bodywork exit and additional louvre panels are extending the top end of the engine cooling capacity, at the expense of car efficiency 2 Cooling Louvres
Larger rear upper exit The main cooling exit at the rear of the bodywork has been enlarged, to increase the available engine cooling to suit the high demands of this circuit.
Extended louvre panel options To further extend the cooling range in extreme conditions, an additional forward louvre panel is available which allows for increased airflow through the radiators.
Reprofiled exhaust tailpipe vane For Mexico, the tailpipe vane configuration has been trimmed to suit the track’s unique ambient and aerodynamic requirements.
